|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Desperate Counter (V)]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-133-Desperate_Counter-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Desperate Counter (V)]] (original, release sheet of 16 December 2011); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Desperate Counter (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Desperate Counter (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Desperate Counter (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack a just-played Interrupt here.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 16 December 2011"), page 2, slip 5 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223114/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 24) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Desperate Counter (V) (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=24, page 24. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=24 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) added “immediately” (“opponent may immediately ▲ any one card”), put a full stop after the Immune to Control icon and changed “stack a just-played Interrupt” to “stack one just-played interrupt” (the card list writes the ▲ icon as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”): “Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may immediately ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control]. OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played interrupt here.”.<ref name="cl-1274_5-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Desperate Counter (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-desperatecounter-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Desperate Counter (V)]]) again, word for word: “Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack a just-played Interrupt here.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034727/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Desperate Counter (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 24)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Desperate Counter (V)]]) again, word for word: “Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may ▲ any one card. [Immune to Control] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack a just-played Interrupt here.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-5-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
